description:
Crawl https://crawler-test.com/ to identify non-standard redirects (Meta Refresh and JavaScript redirects). 

STEPS:
1. Enter 'https://crawler-test.com/' and start the crawl.
2. Wait for the crawl to complete.
3. Go to the 'Response Codes' tab.
4. Filter for 'Redirection (Meta Refresh)' and export these results to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/meta_refresh_audit.csv'.
5. Filter for 'Redirection (JavaScript)' and export these results to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/js_redirect_audit.csv'.
6. Write a summary report at '~/Documents/SEO/reports/redirect_remediation_summary.txt' listing the counts of each type found and why they should be fixed (e.g., converted to 301s).

SUCCESS CRITERIA: Two CSV files with valid data and one text report must be created.
